Dated: 16-06-2026
Advertisement Notice
Interested and eligible candidates are invited to appear for a Walk-in Interview for the
position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) for the project- “Systems-level profiling of
ECM-driven cell fate and circuit dysregulation in Bipolar Disorder”, under the
Prime Minister Early Career Grant, sponsored by the ANRF, Government of India, to
be held on 1st July 2026 at 10:00 AM, at the Centre for Interdisciplinary Research
and Innovations (CIRI), University of Kashmir, Srinagar. The position is purely
temporary and co-terminus with the duration of the project. Candidates are required
to bring, in original, all relevant certificates and marksheets indicating academic
qualifications and percentage of marks, proof of age, certificate of having qualified
NET and/or any equivalent accredited test, and documents evidencing research
experience in the relevant field, if any. Please note that no TA/DA shall be admissible
for appearing in the interview.
